headline: Dubuque tops the table while Loras leads in wins
dek: Loras finished with fifteen wins, two draws, and four losses across all matches, more victories than any other ARC program. Dubuque still claimed the top spot in conference play without a league defeat, while Loras's run stretched into mid-November.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Attacking output drops sharply down the table: Loras's 49 goals exceed the combined total of Buena Vista, Coe, and Simpson.

wire.line: Member programs won 26, drew ten, and lost nineteen outside the league, scoring 94 goals and conceding 71.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dubuque forward Jameson Carl scored eleven goals on 49 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dubuque goalkeeper Riley Johnson made 64 saves while allowing eleven goals for a 0.853 save percentage.

last_match.line: The defeat ends Loras's unbeaten run since the conference opener.
